guard/30199.htm.text: Guard Yates: Halt! Welcome to the town of Oren. There are dangerous areas around the town, so please be careful and prepare yourself. But... to the west there is no harm. As you can see on the map, the motherland of the Elves, the Elven Forest, is nearby. I heard it's a wonderful place, I hope that…
